title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how individuals adopt mask-wearing over time under social influence, information campaigns, supply constraints, and policy enforcement, and estimate downstream effects on compliance and disease transmission.

interactions.name: peer_social_influence
interactions.description: Persons observe mask use among social neighbors and update intentions via social conformity and perceived norms.

interactions.name: household_norm_diffusion
interactions.description: Household members influence each other’s beliefs and share mask inventory.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement_at_location
interactions.description: Locations with mandates check compliance; non-compliant persons may be denied entry or penalized.

interactions.name: information_dissemination
interactions.description: Authorities and information sources broadcast messages that update beliefs based on credibility and reach.

interactions.name: mask_purchase
interactions.description: Persons attempt to buy masks from retailers subject to stock, price, and purchase limits.

interactions.name: disease_transmission
interactions.description: Contacts at locations may transmit infection; mask use reduces probability via source control and wearer protection.

interactions.name: mobility_and_contact
interactions.description: Persons move according to schedules to locations, generating contacts that drive both influence and transmission.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of persons wearing masks each day.

metrics.name: peak_adoption
metrics.description: Maximum daily adoption rate achieved over the simulation.

metrics.name: time_to_70_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until mask adoption first reaches 70% of the population.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_duration
metrics.description: Consecutive days adoption remains above a specified threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: infections_over_time
metrics.description: Daily new infections; used to assess epidemiological impact of adoption.

metrics.name: cases_averted
metrics.description: Difference in cumulative infections vs a no-mask-counterfactual scenario.

metrics.name: noncompliance_events
metrics.description: Count of enforcement-related non-compliance detections across locations.

metrics.name: mask_shortage_days
metrics.description: Number of days retailers experience zero stock.

metrics.name: adoption_by_location_type
metrics.description: Average mask wearing rate stratified by location type (work, school, public).

metrics.name: inequality_of_adoption
metrics.description: Inequality index (e.g., Gini) of adoption across income or demographic groups.

metrics.name: effective_reproduction_number
metrics.description: Estimated Rt accounting for mask-mediated reduction in transmission.
